synopsis: This week's public meetings focused heavily on preparations for the upcoming Fall Special Town Meeting, with multiple boards reviewing warrant articles for open space and recreation projects. The Community Preservation Committee and Trails Committee advanced funding requests for the Peninsula Trail footbridge and the Southborough Golf Club irrigation system. Meanwhile, local boards and commissions previewed early FY28 operating budgets, reviewed conservation and stormwater permits, and discussed Master Plan 2030 implementation.

highlights.title: Peninsula Trail Footbridge Funding Prepared for Town Meeting
highlights.why: Both the Community Preservation Committee and Trails Committee advanced Warrant Article 4 for the Fall Special Town Meeting, seeking $217,318 in Community Preservation Act funds to construct a pedestrian footbridge over Route 30 and secure a MassTrails grant.

highlights.title: Southborough Golf Club Irrigation System Request Reviewed
highlights.why: The Community Preservation Committee reviewed an increased funding request of $433,546 in CPA funds—part of a total $1,087,296 project cost that includes bidding escalation and a new pump station—to replace the irrigation system at the Southborough Golf Club.

highlights.title: Library Begins FY28 Operating Budget Preview
highlights.why: The Library Board of Trustees examined a preliminary FY28 operating budget, discussing staff longevity payouts, material expenditure requirements, and CWMARS network certification standards.

highlights.title: 2013 Conservation Enforcement Order Lifted
highlights.why: The Conservation Commission voted to lift a 2013 enforcement order regarding unpermitted masonry work at 6 Limbrook Road after confirming the work is stable and no active erosion exists.

highlights.title: Master Plan Implementation Strategy Reviewed
highlights.why: The committee debriefed on its recent presentation of Master Plan 2030 to the Planning Board and prepared for upcoming follow-up discussions regarding long-term municipal implementation tracking.

looking_ahead.what: Planning Board meeting (Master Plan 2030 implementation discussion)
Conservation Commission continued public hearings (1 Overlook Drive, 0 Marlborough Junction, 0 Southville Road)
